India wins silver in men's and mixed recurve archery at Asian Games 2026

At the Asian Games 2026, the Indian men's recurve archery team, comprising Dhiraj, Neeraj and Yashdeep, lost to South Korea in the final and secured the silver medal, while the Indian mixed recurve team was defeated 3-5 by China and also settled for silver.
